thesis: The site's single most valuable conversion mechanism is the primary call-to-action, but it is currently a generic 'Learn more' that fails to communicate any specific value or outcome, and the absence of trust signals above the fold compounds the problem by leaving visitors with no reason to engage or confidence to convert.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.summary: 6 of 6 standard security headers are absent, which weakens protection against XSS, clickjacking and downgrade attacks.
findings.problem: 6 of 6 standard security headers are absent, which weakens protection against XSS, clickjacking and downgrade attacks.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Add the missing headers at the CDN or web-server layer; HSTS and X-Content-Type-Options are one-line changes.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live origin: missing HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: No trust signals present
findings.summary: The page lacks any trust indicators such as reviews, guarantees, or security badges, undermining visitor confidence.
findings.problem: The page lacks any trust indicators such as reviews, guarantees, or security badges, undermining visitor confidence.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Example Domain; cta: Learn more; notes: Add testimonials, guarantee, or security badges near CTA.
findings.evidence: The page's main headline reads “Example Domain”. | The only call to action on the page is “Learn more”. | Page copy reads “# Example Domain This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission. Avoid use in operations. [Learn more](https://iana.org/domains/example)”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Missing trust signals above the fold
findings.summary: The homepage shows no sign of returns policy, guarantee, reviews, security badge, so a first-time visitor has nothing to offset purchase risk.
findings.problem: The homepage shows no sign of returns policy, guarantee, reviews, security badge, so a first-time visitor has nothing to offset purchase risk.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Surface review counts, the returns window and a guarantee near the primary call to action.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live homepage: no match for returns policy, guarantee, reviews, security badge.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: No guarantee or return policy
findings.summary: The absence of any guarantee or return policy leaves visitors uncertain about risk, hindering conversion.
findings.problem: The absence of any guarantee or return policy leaves visitors uncertain about risk, hindering conversion.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Example Domain; cta: Learn more; notes: Publish clear guarantee or return policy near CTA.
findings.evidence: Page copy reads “# Example Domain This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission. Avoid use in operations. [Learn more](https://iana.org/domains/example)”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: No credibility or review evidence
findings.summary: The page lacks third-party validation like reviews or ratings, reducing perceived credibility.
findings.problem: The page lacks third-party validation like reviews or ratings, reducing perceived credibility.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Example Domain; cta: Learn more; notes: Add verified reviews, star ratings, or trusted-by logos.
findings.evidence: The page's main headline reads “Example Domain”. | The only call to action on the page is “Learn more”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Weak page metadata
findings.summary: Search and social previews are degraded: page title (absent), meta description, Open Graph tags are missing or outside recommended lengths.
findings.problem: Search and social previews are degraded: page title (absent), meta description, Open Graph tags are missing or outside recommended lengths.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Write a 15-60 char title and 70-160 char description per page; add og:title and og:image for link previews.
findings.evidence: Measured on the homepage: title 0 chars (15-60 recommended); description 0 chars (70-160 recommended); og:title missing, og:image missing.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: No responsive viewport declared
findings.summary: Without a viewport meta tag, mobile browsers render the desktop layout scaled down, making every tap target too small and severely hurting mobile conversion.
findings.problem: Without a viewport meta tag, mobile browsers render the desktop layout scaled down, making every tap target too small and severely hurting mobile conversion.
findings.evidence: Measured on the mobile render: no <meta name="viewport"> present.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

findings.title: No value proposition stated
findings.summary: The page copy fails to communicate what is being sold or why it is valuable, leaving visitors without a reason to engage.
findings.problem: The page copy fails to communicate what is being sold or why it is valuable, leaving visitors without a reason to engage.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Clear value proposition naming product/service and key benefit; cta: Benefit-oriented CTA; notes: Replace generic copy with specific value proposition.
findings.evidence: This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission. | Avoid use in operations.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Single generic call to action
findings.summary: The only CTA 'Learn more' is vague and does not specify the action or outcome, reducing click-through intent.
findings.problem: The only CTA 'Learn more' is vague and does not specify the action or outcome, reducing click-through intent.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Example Domain; cta: Specific, benefit-oriented phrase; notes: Change CTA to clearly state action and benefit.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift
